explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/750: for any f(m) → ∞, is there a graph G of infinite chromatic number in which every m-vertex subgraph contains an independent set of size ≥ m/2 − f(m)? (proved by GPT 5.5 Pro, prompted by Chojecki). The Lean statement: for every f : ℕ → ℝ≥0 tending to ∞, there exist V and G with chromaticNumber = ⊤ such that every S ⊆ V with ncard S = m > 0 (hence finite) contains an independent I with m/2 − f(m) ≤ |I|. The computation is in ℝ≥0 (real division, truncated subtraction), which is harmless as the right side is nonnegative. Taking f nonnegative is justified in the docstring. Faithful.
